row.notes: myteam-g2: Iterates the hash set at saves+0x58..0x68 of career save/profile objects (component at obj+0x38->+0x260), skips those with +0x2ac set, calls the std::function predicate (param+0x38; throws Ne_Std_ThrowBadFunctionCall if empty) and returns the last match.
